description: Configuration for Commentsmith, a configurable comment formatter.

extends.description: Preset names to inherit from, applied left to right so a later entry wins.

items.description: A preset name, such as bullets.

printWidth.description: The column comment body text is wrapped to.

transforms.description: The transforms to run, in the order they run in. Order is significant: each transform sees what the previous one produced.

items.description: A transform to run, and the options to run it with.

enabled.description: Whether to run this transform. Set to false to suppress an entry inherited from a preset without restating the rest of its pipeline.

name.description: The registered transform's name, such as body/rewrap.

options.description: Options merged over the transform's own defaults. The merge is shallow, so a nested value is replaced rather than combined.

title: Commentsmith configuration
